name: JellyToneDown
description: Jellyfin plays a theme song in the background when you open a series or a movie, and offers no way to turn it down. JellyToneDown adds one. A server-wide default plus optional per-user levels, applied to theme songs and the audio of theme videos and to nothing else. The adjustment is made on the server, so it reaches every client - the web player, Swiftfin, Findroid, the Android TV app, Kodi and Infuse alike - rather than only the ones that happen to expose a volume control. Files in your library are never modified; adjusted copies live in Jellyfin's cache. The plugin does not download, assign, rename or otherwise manage theme music. It only changes how loud it is.
overview: Adjust the volume of theme music. Just that.
